text.description_html:
Field Enterprises RPR-320, Solid Brass 3 Rectangular Ring Pull

When we saw the Large Rectangular Finger Ring Pull we thought first of how beautiful it would look as a handle on a modern barn door. Though as we thought more about it, we came to realize that this ring pull would look great on any lightweight door or drawer. The inch by 2 inch size makes it big enough for any size hand to get a comfortable grip. It is available in 5 finishes including contemporary polished chrome and polished nickel. The Rectangular Ring Pull is made from solid brass.

Also Available: Small Rectangular Finger Ring Pull

Specifications and Features of the Rectangular RPR320 Ring Pull:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Overall Length: 3"
  • Overall Width: 2-1/32"
  • Grip: 3/8" square
  • Grip Cutout Length: 2-5/16"
  • Grip Cutout Width: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Mount Length: 1/2" square
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
